question_en: What is in the sample and how often do events/anomalies occur?
问题_cn: 样本包含什么、事件与异常出现频率如何？
implementation_en: Counts, shares, date coverage and taxonomy
实施_cn: 数量、占比、日期覆盖与分类
source_files: Table1/2/3/6; event and policy source tables
interpretation_limit_cn: 描述事实，不进行因果推断

question_en: How do market outcomes change before and after an event?
问题_cn: 事件前后市场指标如何变化？
implementation_en: Pre10 versus post5/10/20 means; direction-aligned returns
实施_cn: 前10日与后5/10/20日均值；方向一致收益
interpretation_limit_cn: 事件重叠与非随机时点限制解释

question_en: When does the response start and is there a pre-trend?
问题_cn: 反应何时开始，政策前是否已有趋势？
implementation_en: Relative-day indicators with fixed effects and clustered errors
实施_cn: 相对日虚拟变量、固定效应与聚类标准误
interpretation_limit_cn: 前趋势意味着不能直接解释为净政策效应

question_en: Does the result survive dependence, few clusters and multiple testing?
问题_cn: 结果能否经受相关性、有限簇和多重检验？
implementation_en: Cluster robust SE, exact/Monte Carlo wild bootstrap, placebo, BH q-values
实施_cn: 聚类稳健标准误、wild bootstrap、安慰剂、BH q值
interpretation_limit_cn: 同时报告未显著结果和所有校正范围

question_en: Does the model work on held-out groups?
问题_cn: 模型在留出样本上是否有效？
implementation_en: Grouped out-of-fold AUC, Brier, bootstrap CI and permutation p
实施_cn: 分组样本外AUC、Brier、bootstrap区间与置换p值
interpretation_limit_cn: 当前正向预测未建立，反向仅提示性
